{{Quote|Some of the slaves are killing each other. We don't know if they're mad, or hungry, desperate... or if there's a faction of slaves who've turned on the rest.|Corian Shye, to an individual affiliated with the Sith Empire|<ref name="TOR:TSK" />}}
[[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] '''Corian Shye''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He observed the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] and also observed their ritualistic [[Death/Legends|killings]]. When an Imperial individual arrived, he asked them if they could attempt to search the [[Unchained|cultists]] for clues to why this was happening.<ref name="TOR:TSK" />
